summary:
About the job
Key Areas of Responsibilities
responsibilities: Perform POC for latest technologies and new enhancement
Maintain / Enhance the system as and when any client request comes
Come up with high level component design & system architecture for new changes
Cover all non-functional aspects during software development
Work closely with cross functional teams with different jurisdiction
Stay updated with emerging technologies and industry best practices; apply them to improve development processes
Ensure applications adhere to security standards and company policies
Participate in unit testing and debugging to ensure reliable software delivery
required_skills: Bachelor’s degree in computer engineering or related fields
Experience in Java & related technologies, good knowledge on SQL/PLSQL
Familiarity with agile development environment and concepts of Scrum
Good to have knowledge on Docker, GitHub, GitHub Actions
nice_to_have_skills: Excellent command of / fluent in both spoken and written in English
